# ExcaliDash

> ExcaliDash is an open-source (GNU LGPL-3.0), self-hosted Excalidraw workspace and a self-hosted alternative to Excalidraw+. It wraps the Excalidraw editor in a dashboard with persistent server-side storage, collections, search, real-time collaboration, version history, and SSO, deployed as a single Docker Compose stack. It is an independent project and is not affiliated with Excalidraw.

- Website and docs: https://excalidash.xyz/
- Source code: https://github.com/ZimengXiong/ExcaliDash
- License: GNU LGPL v3.0
- Author: Zimeng Xiong (https://zimengxiong.com/)

## Core capabilities

- Persistent drawing storage in SQLite (default, zero-config) or PostgreSQL, instead of browser localStorage.
- Collections, search, and visual drawing previews on a dashboard accessible from any device.
- Built-in self-hosted Socket.IO real-time collaboration with live named cursors, presence avatars, and viewport follow mode. No separate excalidraw-room container and no traffic to public Excalidraw servers.
- Sharing of drawings and collections with view/edit roles and expiring links.
- Automatic drawing version history with on-canvas preview and two-click restore.
- Local accounts and native OpenID Connect (OIDC) SSO for Authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID, Authelia, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Google Workspace. Auth modes: local, hybrid, oidc_enforced, disabled.
- Scoped personal API keys (exd_...) for REST and Socket.IO sync from external tools and integrations.
- S3-compatible image storage (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2, Wasabi).
- Automated scheduled SQLite backups (BACKUP_SCHEDULE, BACKUP_DIR, BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS).
- Import and export of standard .excalidraw files and full .excalidash workspace archives with collections, version history, and images.
- Works behind Caddy, Nginx, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, or Cloudflare Tunnel; deployable on Coolify, Portainer, and Dokploy.

## Quick start

Requires Docker Engine or Docker Desktop, Docker Compose v2, and a free host port 6767.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ZimengXiong/ExcaliDash.git
cd ExcaliDash
docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
```

Open http://localhost:6767 and create the administrator account. Drawings persist in the backend-data Docker volume. Behind a reverse proxy, point it at host port 6767 (container port 8080), forward WebSocket upgrades on /socket.io/, set FRONTEND_URL to the public https:// origin, and set TRUST_PROXY to the proxy hop count.

## Guides

- [Self-Hosted Excalidraw Guides](https://excalidash.xyz/guides): Step-by-step guides to self-host Excalidraw with Docker Compose, real-time collaboration, OIDC SSO, reverse proxies, PostgreSQL, and S3.
- [How to Self-Host Excalidraw](https://excalidash.xyz/guides/self-host-excalidraw): Compare the official Excalidraw Docker image, excalidraw-room, and ExcaliDash.
- [Self-Hosted Excalidraw+ Alternative](https://excalidash.xyz/guides/excalidraw-plus-alternative): Open-source self-hosted alternative to Excalidraw+ with persistent drawings, collections, live collaboration, version history, and OIDC SSO.
- [Excalidraw OIDC & SSO Setup](https://excalidash.xyz/guides/excalidraw-oidc-sso): Native OpenID Connect SSO with Authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID, Authelia, and group-to-admin mapping.
- [Excalidraw Reverse Proxy & HTTPS](https://excalidash.xyz/guides/excalidraw-reverse-proxy): HTTPS and WebSocket upgrades behind Caddy, Nginx, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, or Cloudflare Tunnel.
- [Excalidraw with PostgreSQL & S3](https://excalidash.xyz/guides/excalidraw-postgresql-s3): PostgreSQL 16 database and AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, or MinIO image storage.

## Deploy

- [Deploy with Docker Compose](https://excalidash.xyz/deploy/docker): Pin image tags, enable an HTTPS reverse proxy, schedule SQLite backups, upgrade safely, and troubleshoot.
- [Deploy on Coolify, Portainer & Dokploy](https://excalidash.xyz/deploy/coolify-portainer): Standalone Docker Compose templates for Coolify, Portainer Stacks, and Dokploy.
